candidates.formal_type:
∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group.{u_1} G] (V : Type u_2) [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup.{u_2} V]
  [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace.{0, u_2} Complex V] [FiniteDimensional.{0, u_2} Complex V]
  (ρ : Representation.{0, u_1, u_2} Complex G V),
  (∀ (g : G) (v w : V),
      Eq.{1}
        (Inner.inner.{0, u_2} Complex
          (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g) v)
          (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g) w))
        (Inner.inner.{0, u_2} Complex v w)) →
    ∀ (W : Submodule.{0, u_2} Complex V),
      (∀ (g : G) (w : V),
          Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} W w →
            Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} W
              (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g)
                w)) →
        Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun W' =>
          And
            (∀ (g : G) (w : V),
              Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} W' w →
                Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} W'
                  (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1}
                    (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g) w))
            (IsCompl.{u_2} W W')

source_text: Every invariant subspace of a finite-dimensional unitary representation has an invariant orthogonal complement, hence the representation is completely reducible.
